incidentSample.title: DB deadlock spikes latency
incidentSample.aiHypothesis: The ledger-postgres-db experienced a sustained deadlock on the ledger_accounts table, as evidenced by repeated DeadlockDetectedException logs and a 6400 ms lock wait. This blocked the SELECT FOR UPDATE call, causing billing-service to return 500 errors and api-gateway to timeout with 504, driving the observed 28.6% error-rate spike.
aiRecommendations: Investigate and refactor the transaction that locks ledger_accounts to use shorter lock scopes or optimistic concurrency
Add appropriate indexes or partitioning to reduce row contention on ledger_accounts
Configure PostgreSQL deadlock timeout and enable automatic retry logic in billing-service for transient deadlocks
Monitor pg_stat_activity and pg_locks dashboards and set alerts for lock-wait times exceeding 2 seconds
